sectionOrganization.issue: The Projects section lists the 2024 Riyadh Housing Prices Analysis before the 2025 Student Attendance Dashboard, which is not in reverse-chronological order like the rest of the CV.
sectionOrganization.suggestion: Move the Student Attendance Dashboard (2025) above the Riyadh Housing Prices Analysis (2024) so the most recent project appears first.

keywordUsage.issue: The CV describes designing a star schema for the Student Attendance Dashboard, but 'Data Modeling' is not listed as a skill, which is a common keyword recruiters search for in Data Analyst roles.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Add 'Data Modeling' to the Skills section since the graduation project already demonstrates this capability.

keywordUsage.issue: The skill 'Statistics' is listed without specifying any technique, even though the Riyadh Housing Prices project applied a regression model.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Make the skill more specific, for example 'Statistics (Regression Analysis)', to match the technique actually used in the project.

readability.issue: The bullet 'Worked on data cleaning tasks for the team' under the Sahel Retail Company role uses a weak verb and has no measurable result, unlike the other bullets in the CV.
readability.suggestion: Rewrite it with a strong action verb and a quantifiable outcome, for example specifying the dataset size or time saved from the cleaning work.

contentFormatting.issue: Experience and Education entries use full month-year dates (e.g., 'Sep 2025 - Present'), while Projects and Certifications only show the year (e.g., '2024', '2025'), creating inconsistent date formatting across the CV.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Use the same month-year format in the Projects and Certifications sections as used in Experience and Education for consistency.
